purpose: Cite adopted vocabulary for each dataset's existing evidence; never compute an external standard's score or combine the references into a scoring method.

application.scope: Apply this field crosswalk independently to every manifest dataset. Field names identify evidence to consult, not findings about every dataset.
application.missing_evidence: A missing, null, empty or insufficient field remains unknown. Do not substitute a neutral value or infer conformity from a field's presence.
application.hierarchy: DQAF is the primary spine; ODIN is secondary openness context; the 5-star scheme is a descriptor. These references are not blended or weighted.
application.attribution_boundary: Each attribution cites the author of an external element. DataPulse owns the local evidence selection and probe observations; no citation implies an external assessment, endorsement or verdict.

local_evidence.boundary: Manifest declarations and probe references remain local evidence. No local measurement is renamed as a DQAF score, ODIN score or awarded star rating.

fields.verified_at: Date DataPulse last verified upstream lifecycle state; not a content freshness or upstream publication date.
fields.real_status: Local observation of upstream lifecycle state; not an external quality judgement.
fields.probe_note: Local explanation of a probe result or limitation.
fields.health_report: Reference to DataPulse's report; the reference alone does not establish what the probe measured or validate upstream statistics.
fields.expected_record_count: Local declared record-count expectation, possibly null; not an observed count or statistical consistency assessment.
fields.refresh_frequency: Declared update cadence; not independently verified periodicity or a freshness measurement.
fields.freshness_policy: DataPulse's content-date interpretation and probe policy; not an IMF assessment or an upstream publication date.
fields.methodology_version: Version of DataPulse's own methodology; not an adopted authority's score or version.
fields.attestation_ref: Reference to local probe provenance; not certification by any adopted authority.

standards.attribution: International Monetary Fund, Data Quality Assessment Framework, Generic Framework (May 2012), Appendix IV of the e-GDDS Guide for Participants and Users.
standards.assessment_boundary: DQAF requires expert assessment. These citations and partial local signals are not IMF assessments or dataset scores.

elements.definition: Revisions, as a gauge of reliability, are tracked and mined for the information they may provide.
elements.attribution: International Monetary Fund, DQAF Generic Framework (May 2012), element 3.5, e-GDDS Guide Appendix IV.
elements.evidence_note: No manifest field records studies of statistical revisions or their use in compilation. Lifecycle verification, local methodology versions and probe attestations do not evidence revision studies.

elements.attribution: International Monetary Fund, DQAF Generic Framework (May 2012), element 4.1, e-GDDS Guide Appendix IV.
elements.evidence_note: Declared cadence, local content-date policy and a probe report reference provide context to consult per dataset. They do not establish compliance with international dissemination standards. verified_at concerns lifecycle verification, not timeliness; reference data do not acquire freshness dates through this mapping.

elements.attribution: International Monetary Fund, DQAF Generic Framework (May 2012), element 4.2, e-GDDS Guide Appendix IV.
elements.evidence_note: No manifest field establishes statistical consistency within a dataset, over time or with other statistics. An expected record count, schema identifier or health report pointer is insufficient.

elements.attribution: International Monetary Fund, DQAF Generic Framework (May 2012), element 5.2, e-GDDS Guide Appendix IV.
elements.evidence_note: Catalogue metadata and a local report reference supply limited descriptive context. They do not establish accessible, current upstream documentation of concepts, classifications or statistical techniques.

standards.attribution: Open Data Watch, Open Data Inventory (ODIN), 2024/25 Methodology Guide, openness elements.
standards.assessment_boundary: ODIN operationalises Open Definition 2.1 and assesses countries. Its 1 / 0.5 / 0 marks belong to ODIN's assessment; DataPulse neither assigns those marks nor produces dataset ODIN scores.

elements.attribution: Open Data Watch, ODIN 2024/25 Methodology Guide, machine-readable formats openness element.
elements.evidence_note: No manifest field declares or verifies the returned data format. An API-looking URL, filename extension or schema identifier alone does not evidence machine readability.

elements.attribution: Open Data Watch, ODIN 2024/25 Methodology Guide, non-proprietary formats openness element.
elements.evidence_note: No manifest field verifies a data format or its non-proprietary status. A declared licence is not evidence of format.

elements.attribution: Open Data Watch, ODIN 2024/25 Methodology Guide, reference metadata openness element.
elements.evidence_note: Declared source and responsible agency supply partial metadata context. A name is not an indicator definition, and verified_at is not an upstream upload date. The manifest does not evidence all ODIN metadata requirements.

elements.element: download options - bulk downloads, APIs, customisable export
elements.attribution: Open Data Watch, ODIN 2024/25 Methodology Guide, download options openness element.
elements.evidence_note: Declared access addresses identify where to investigate available downloads. record_source_url exists only on some rows. These addresses do not confirm working bulk downloads, APIs, customisable exports or the full set of options.

elements.element: open data license or open data terms of use
elements.attribution: Open Data Watch, ODIN 2024/25 Methodology Guide, open data license or open terms of use openness element.
elements.evidence_note: Declared licence and upstream attribution are evidence to inspect per dataset, not confirmation of an open licence. Unstated or restrictive terms remain unresolved; DataPulse does not make ODIN's legal or scoring judgement.

standards.attribution: Tim Berners-Lee, Linked Data, Design Issues, Is your Linked Open Data 5 Star? (added 2010).
standards.assessment_boundary: Levels below identify the scheme's vocabulary only. They are cumulative descriptors, not awarded ratings or an authority's verdict on a DataPulse dataset.

elements.element: 1 = on the web under an open license
elements.attribution: Tim Berners-Lee, Linked Data, Design Issues, 5-star scheme, first level (2010).
elements.evidence_note: A declared web address and licence supply context. They do not confirm current accessibility or legal openness, and no star is awarded.

elements.attribution: Tim Berners-Lee, Linked Data, Design Issues, 5-star scheme, second level (2010).
elements.evidence_note: No manifest field verifies that the returned upstream data are structured. The structure of DataPulse's manifest itself is not upstream evidence.

elements.attribution: Tim Berners-Lee, Linked Data, Design Issues, 5-star scheme, third level (2010).
elements.evidence_note: No manifest field verifies the upstream data format or its non-proprietary status.

elements.attribution: Tim Berners-Lee, Linked Data, Design Issues, 5-star scheme, fourth level (2010).
elements.evidence_note: No manifest field records upstream URIs denoting data items with linked-data semantics. A catalogue URL or local dataset identifier does not evidence this level.

elements.element: 5 = linked to other data for context
elements.attribution: Tim Berners-Lee, Linked Data, Design Issues, 5-star scheme, fifth level (2010).
elements.evidence_note: No manifest field records semantic links from upstream data items to other data. Source, report and attestation links provide provenance rather than evidence of this level.
